verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Solo/Go reader pairing via Cloud API with no distance limitation, simultaneous multi-reader support, and a sandbox Virtual Solo flow to test pairing before switching to a physical device, plus Tap to Pay as a readerless option — all supporting quick onboarding. However, evidence is entirely developer/API-facing; there's no first-party or hands-on account of the merchant-ops experience of physically pairing a reader via the consumer POS app or a documented "minutes to first payment" onboarding flow. Missing for 10: end-user POS-app pairing walkthrough, timing/UX evidence, and independent hands-on confirmation of a fast setup.
